---
name: Research proposal
about: A measurement or study about visibility, auditability or Phantom C
labels: research
---

Read [docs/research/EXPERIMENTAL_METHOD.md](https://github.com/hayagrivai-labs/phantom/blob/main/docs/research/EXPERIMENTAL_METHOD.md) first. Proposals aiming to evade security products or conceal execution from authorized owners will be closed.

**Property studied** (one of: readability, detectability, auditability, provenance, execution visibility)

**Observer and environment** (tool, version, OS; systems you own or are authorized to test)

**Falsifiable hypothesis** (bounded, never "cannot be detected")

**Design** - corpus, benign controls, sample size, how inputs are generated

**Measurement and error analysis** - what counts as a positive; false positives/negatives

**Reproducibility** - versions, commands, generators

**Ethics and security considerations**

**Plan to publish negative results**
